note: Both sets attempt to extract data points from the provided plots, but both struggle significantly with accuracy. Many values are misread from the curves (e.g., twist at r/R=0 is >15, not 15 or 14; relative thickness at r/R=0 is 100%, not 50% or 95%). Because both sets contain a high number of inaccurate or hallucinated data points, neither is clearly better.
